Book Lofoten back to Bergen for 30 Sept — the 40 kg is in Bergen and the Amsterdam flight leaves from there
Buy the second checked bag online when booking BGO-AMS. Two bags at 20 kg beats one at 40 kg — KLM heavy-bag fees are worse than an extra piece

Do NOT courier the luggage Norway to Netherlands. Norway is outside the EU customs union and the Dutch removal-goods exemption needs proof you are settling there, which you are not. Carry it as checked baggage
Hike Trolltunga on 13 or 14 Sept while the upper shuttle still runs — saves 4 km and 400 m each way
Call Skydive Bovec (+386 41 888 707) — ask about the minimum-numbers rule for a solo jump in October
Book the Voss tandem for Sunday 20 Sept; the student discount only runs Mon-Fri, and Monday leaves no weather buffer
Phone the three TMB winter rooms: Croix du Bonhomme, Elisabetta, Bonatti
Camping des Glaciers La Fouly shuts 4 Oct — book a bed instead for the night of 23 Oct
TMB go / no-go: chamonix-meteo plus the Chamonix and Courmayeur webcams
Clocks go back tonight — dark by 17:30 for the last TMB days
Post the alpine kit to Amsterdam FROM CHAMONIX: bag, mat, spikes, gaiters, shell, insulation, messenger. EU to EU — do not post from Geneva
Decide the Lofoten question: keep it and add an Oslo overnight on 30 Sept, or swap to Jotunheimen and save two flights
Last dive at least 24 h before the 13 Nov flight — no diving on the 12th
Check whether the Eurail pass is continuous or flexi — version C burns a lot of travel days
Book the AVE and TGV passholder reservations now. Spanish and French quotas are small and sell out; they are the only real cost in version C
Cabo de Gata: some centres want a medical certificate. Sort it before you arrive

detours.name: Finse — Hoth
detours.blurb: Empire Strikes Back began shooting here on 5 March 1979, on Hardangerjokulen about three miles from the town, in -29F and a storm that dropped eighteen feet of snow. The blizzard in the film is real weather. Hotel Finse 1222 housed the crew.
detours.note: Free — you are already at this station.

detours.name: Romsdalseggen ridge
detours.blurb: About 10 km with 950 m of climb and 1,320 m of descent, finishing on foot into Andalsnes. An exposed ridge with steep drops on both sides and views over Romsdalen, Trollveggen and the fjord.
detours.note: Already in the route as an activity inside the Andalsnes stop. Insert it here only if you cut that stop, or want the ridge to have its own day rather than sharing four with the via ferrata. One-way: shuttle from Andalsnes station to Venjedalssetra, about NOK 250 pp on 2025 figures, book ahead. Not in poor visibility or high wind — swap it for a rest day instead.

detours.name: Torre de Mesa Roldan
detours.blurb: The flat-topped headland north of Agua Amarga, inside Cabo de Gata natural park. Stood in for part of Meereen — the surrender of the Masters of Yunkai, Volantis and Astapor.
detours.note: Inside the park. A surface-interval walk between dive days.

detours.name: Alcazaba de Almeria
detours.blurb: The 12th-century Moorish fortress above the city — Dorne, capital of House Martell, in season 6. Merged in post with the Alcazar of Seville, so the two share scenes. The bloody-deed scene was shot in the Patio del Gobernador. The Muralla de Jayran curtain wall runs out from it.
detours.note: Pairs with Tabernas in one long day from Almeria.

detours.name: Tabernas desert and El Chorrillo
detours.blurb: The Dothraki Sea. The Rambla del Cautivo and Rambla del Buho held 100 horses and 500 extras for the Dothraki march; the Vaes Dothrak set went up at El Chorrillo de Pechina, a deserted mining hamlet in the Sierra de Alhamilla about 15 km northeast of Almeria. Tabernas also doubled for the Wild West in The Good, the Bad and the Ugly, and the western towns still stand as visitable sets.
detours.note: 30 km north of Almeria. Bus or a cheap car hire for the day.

detours.name: Girona — Braavos
detours.blurb: The Jewish Quarter streets are where Arya trains in public; the 12th-century Arab Baths are where she flees the Waif; the cathedral is the Tower of the Hand.
detours.note: On the rail line, about an hour from Barcelona. Easiest detour on the list.

detours.name: Castle of Santa Florentina, Canet de Mar
detours.blurb: The 11th-century castle that doubled for House Tarly in season 6.
detours.note: Private property — visits by appointment only. Arrange before you travel.

detours.name: Osuna — the fighting pits
detours.blurb: The Plaza de Toros was the fighting pits of Meereen; the crew shot there for fourteen days. Osuna also has the only Game of Thrones museum in Europe, and tourism rose 75% after the show aired.
detours.note: Inside on Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays only. A real detour from Malaga, not a side trip.

detours.name: Soca valley — Prince Caspian
detours.blurb: Reported to have stood in for Narnia in Prince Caspian. You are rafting this river anyway, so the cost is zero if it holds up.
detours.note: I have not verified this. Check before planning around it.

detours.name: Strada della Forra, Lake Garda
detours.blurb: Reported location of the Quantum of Solace opening car chase, on the gorge road above Tremosine.
detours.note: Unverified. Half an hour from Arco if true.

detours.name: Cortina d'Ampezzo
detours.blurb: Reported location for Cliffhanger and earlier Bond work, in the mountains you are already walking.
detours.note: Unverified. Would be free if it holds.

ddays.label: Permit early — wait for the dark
ddays.gain: Six nights in Lofoten from 22 to 27 Sept, and still 19 days in Europe before the TMB — two more than the baseline. An early permit buys days at both ends.
ddays.lose: Andalsnes. The eight days between the card arriving and D-Day are spent in Norway, not Europe — that is the price of darkness.

ddays.label: Permit early — same departure
ddays.gain: Identical to the 20 Sept case. Anything before about 26 Sept lands on the same D-Day, because Lofoten needs to sit in the last week of September for darkness.

ddays.label: As planned
ddays.gain: Everything fits: Andalsnes back in, five nights in Lofoten from 25 to 29 Sept.
ddays.lose: Nothing, but the last Lofoten day is spent flying back to Bergen for the luggage.

ddays.label: Late
ddays.gain: Six nights in Lofoten from 29 Sept to 4 Oct — the darkest and statistically best aurora window of any scenario. Besseggen too.
ddays.lose: The Dolomites entirely. Two rushed days there would be worse than none, with the rifugi shut and both routes needing lifts that may have stopped.

ddays.label: Very late — the last date that works
ddays.gain: Seven nights in Lofoten from 3 to 9 Oct, plus Jotunheimen and the Lysefjord. A proper month in Norway.
ddays.lose: Slovenia and the Dolomites both gone. Past this date the TMB start slips and you are back in the snow argument.
